frame_count_reconciliation.root_cause_of_discrepancy: In M6, the tar member matching used string prefix checking without a trailing slash ('/'). Because 'change-weather/scenario-10' through 'scenario-16' start with 'change-weather/scenario-1', all 8 weather variants were grouped under scenario-1 (8 x 60 = 480 frames), and 7 spawn-props variants were grouped under scenario-1 (7 x 60 = 420 frames). 'running-pedestrian/scenario-1' had exactly 60 frames. Total = 480 + 420 + 60 = 960 frames. Ticks in per_frame_detections.json for weather and props were therefore interleaved 60-tick sequences across multiple scenario subdirectories.
frame_count_reconciliation.temporal_tracking_prerequisite: For temporal object tracking, frames must not be interleaved across distinct scenarios. Milestone 7 strictly uses exact scenario prefixes with trailing slashes ('.../scenario-1/') to isolate individual continuous recordings.

latency_semantics_clarification.measurement_boundary: Torch model forward pass alone (model([tensor_img])) on CPU (8 cores).
latency_semantics_clarification.difference_explanation: The ~608 ms/frame end-to-end pipeline includes on-the-fly Gzip tar stream extraction, PIL JPEG decode, and tensor transforms, whereas 265 ms is pure model inference.
